checks.claim: Photoelectric alarms aim a light beam away from a sensor; smoke scatters the light onto the sensor and sets off the alarm
checks.why: Two fire-protection sources describe the angled source and sensor and the scattering.

checks.claim: Smoke alarm horns sound at least 85 decibels at 10 feet
checks.why: Manufacturer manuals give at least 85 dBA at 10 feet under UL 217.

checks.claim: The NFPA says to replace smoke alarms every 10 years
checks.why: NFPA 72 requires replacement at least every 10 years.

sources.title: NFPA: Smoke Alarms Need Replacement Every 10 Years
